mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT MSG_KEY AS msgid, MSG_TYPE AS messagetype, MESSAGE AS msg, MESSAGE AS msg_sms, SUBJECT AS smslmstit, CALL_TO AS phn, CALL_FROM AS smssender, -- 오라클 DATETIME형 예약 시간을 yyyyMMddHHmmss 문자열 형태로 포맷팅 TO_CHAR(RES_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS reservedt, SENDER_KEY AS profile, TEMPLATE_CODE AS tmplid, BUTTON AS button1, SERVER_INFO AS serverinfo FROM ${msg_table} WHERE MSG_STATE = '0' AND MSG_TYPE = #{msg_type} -- 예약시간 방어막 (NULL이거나 현재 시간보다 같거나 과거인 것만 조회) AND ( RES_DATE IS NULL OR RES_DATE <= SYSDATE ) ORDER BY MSG_KEY ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 200
